summary: One run on the real data takes about 6 seconds and all 19 quality checks pass; the transcript of two consecutive runs and the report is committed as `infra/warehouse/SAMPLE_RUN.md`. Table 19 lists the tables it produces.
tables: One row per landed MAST record: key, framework, model, benchmark, trajectory length and preview, raw labels, source digest, load time
One row per example per split, as landed
Validated traces; the 4 all-null records excluded
One row per trace per failure code (1,638 x 14)
Trace facts with keys to the four dimensions, failure and category counts
Split, span count, query, reference and context word counts
Stage, start, finish, duration, rows in and out, status, git commit, error
